content.title: Starbucks Released a Secret Menu Item for Hannah Montana’s 20th Anniversary: How to Get It
content.text: Miley Cyrus as "Hannah Montana"; Hannah Montana drink at Starbucks. Credit : DISNEY CHANNEL/BOB D'AMICO; Starbucks NEED TO KNOW Starbucks launched a Hannah Montana-themed drink for the show’s 20th anniversary available through the app or custom ordersThe limited-time drink features strawberry açaí with raspberry cold foam and syrup and is available until April 5When a fan pointed out that Hannah hated raspberries on the show, Starbucks responded, "Miley's made peace with raspberries 20 years later" Like Miley Stewart’s double life, Starbucks’ new Hannah Montana-themed drink is the best of both worlds. The coffee chain launched Hannah’s Secret Popstar Refresher, a colorful beverage blending strawberry açaí and raspberry cold foam that honors the Disney Channel sitcom’s 20th anniversary on Tuesday, March 24. While the item isn’t featured on Starbucks’ official menu, customers can order it on the mobile app. A description of the fruity drink says it’s “ready for its close-up,” adding, “Strawberry açaí meets a layer of raspberry cold foam, plus an added splash of raspberry syrup for a popstar-perfect drink.” If not using the app, Starbucks advises guests to order a Grande Strawberry Açaí Refresher, with no strawberry inclusions, and add raspberry cold foam and two pumps of raspberry syrup. According to a press release, the limited-time drink will be available between March 23 and April 5. Fans can also expect “a totally rockin’ playlist” from Hannah Montana to play at U.S. Starbucks locations on March 24. Miley Cyrus stars as 'Hannah Montana' on the Disney Channel. DISNEY CHANNEL/BOB D'AMICO While the drink celebrates the beloved teen series, Miley Cyrus’ character may not have been a fan of the concoction. In the 2007 episode "Smells Like Teen Sellout," Hannah is offered a perfume sponsorship, but can’t stomach the scent since she once became ill after a raspberry pie-eating contest. “Even a whiff of raspberry makes me sick,” she says. One commenter on a Starbucks Instagram post pointed out, "But Miley Stewart hates raspberries…" The brand responded, "miley's made peace with raspberries 20 years later." Disney+ will air an upcoming tribute, Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special, on March 24. Related Stories Disney announced that the special, filmed in front of a live audience, will include an "in-depth interview" with Cyrus, plus never-before-archival seen footage. "Hannah Montana opened the door for so many fans to dream big, sing loud, and embrace every side of themselves, which is why its legacy continues to shine across generations,” Ayo Davis, Disney Branded Television president, said in a press release. "Partnering with Miley on this special is a dream, and we want it to be a love letter to the fans, who remain as passionate today as they were when the series debuted almost 20 years ago," Davis' statement continued. Cyrus said in an earlier statement about a trailer for the special: "Hannah Montana will always be a part of who I am. What started as a TV show became a shared experience that shaped my life and the lives of so many fans, and I’ll always be thankful for that connection." "The fact that it still means so much to people all these years later is something I’m very proud of," she continued. "This 'Hannahversary' is my way of celebrating and thanking the fans who’ve stood by me for 20 years."
